title: Keep visible wire paths easy to follow
summary: Editorial convention: prefer short orthogonal paths and avoid unnecessary bends or wires passing through unrelated symbols.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; editorial convention informed by the cited background.
verification: Follow every visible path without ambiguity.
limitations: Editorial convention, not a source-mandated rule. Diagonal bridge drawings can be clearer; schematic paths are not PCB routes.

title: Distinguish junctions from wire crossings
summary: Use actual electrical junctions for intended connections; inspect crossings at final scale.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; retain cited tool or library scope.
verification: Confirm crossing connectivity in the netlist.
limitations: Graphic dots are not electrical junctions.

title: Make label scope explicit across sheets
summary: KiCad local labels connect within a sheet; global labels span the design; hierarchical connections use matching sheet interfaces.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; retain cited tool or library scope.
limitations: Replacing label types can change connectivity.

title: Keep bus members and names explicit
summary: Verify named bus members and their connections; a bus-entry graphic alone creates no connection.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; retain cited tool or library scope.
limitations: Visual bundling does not prove connectivity.

title: Use short meaningful net names consistently
summary: Use concise functional names and consistent rail notation so a reader can recognize signals.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; retain cited tool or library scope.
limitations: Renaming a net can alter connectivity and downstream constraints.

title: Show active-low meaning without ambiguous notation
summary: Preserve active-low meaning in symbol pin names. KLC uses an overbar and avoids duplicating an existing negation prefix.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; retain cited tool or library scope.
verification: Compare displayed names with actual signal meaning.
limitations: KLC pin formatting is not a requirement to rename all project nets.

title: Align related interface pins to reduce crossings
summary: Keep interface groups in a consistent order to make related signals easy to follow.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; retain cited tool or library scope.
verification: Check pin numbers and net identities.
limitations: Only graphical ordering is discussed; physical pin reassignment needs separate authorization and verification.

citations.locator: S4.2 pin groups and bus ordering

title: Mark intentionally unused pins accurately
summary: Use no-connect flags only for intentionally unconnected pins.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; retain cited tool or library scope.
limitations: Do not suppress required connections for appearance.
